snippet.title: Play the Heave Ho 2 PC Demo Now on Steam | Out July 16
snippet.description:
Go to http://heaveho2.com/ for more!
Play the online and local co-op 2-4 player PC demo and wishlist now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2802740/Heave_Ho_2/ 

Heave Ho 2 releases on PC, Nintendo Switch, and Nintendo Switch 2 on July 16.

Get those grabby hands a-clenching, it's nearly time to swing your besties to victory or splattery death in the void below. The riotous 2-4 player party game sequel takes the couch co-op carnage online for the first time, packed with new gameplay features and 8 all-new worlds to conquer together - from weightless space to kitchen chaos.

Visit our website for more info: https://www.devolverdigital.com/
